title: CORAL: Curriculum-Optimized Reward Adaptation for LiDAR-Based Goal-Directed Urban Driving
abstract: arXiv:2608.14332v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning is promising for autonomous urban driving, but long-horizon goal-directed navigation asks a policy to acquire several competing behaviors at once--reaching a distant goal, tracking a route, avoiding obstacles, obeying signals--and a fixed objective gives no order in which to learn them. This paper presents CORAL, which advances two schedules together: a five-stage curriculum that progressively lengthens routes and tightens behavioral constraints, and a stage-aware reward whose component weights shift emphasis from mission progress toward route following, safety, smoothness, and rule compliance as the task hardens. translated_title: CORAL：基于LiDAR的城市目标导向驾驶的课程优化奖励自适应方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14332v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：强化学习在自主城市驾驶中具有前景，但长时程目标导向导航要求策略同时习得多种竞争性行为——到达远处目标、跟踪路线、避开障碍物、遵守信号——而固定的目标函数无法规定学习这些行为的顺序。本文提出CORAL，它同时推进两个调度机制：一个五阶段课程，逐步延长路线并收紧行为约束；以及一个阶段感知奖励，其组件权重随任务难度增加，从任务进展转向路线跟随、安全性、平滑性和规则合规性。该策略是一个多流Actor-Critic网络，在CARLA中使用近端策略优化（PPO）训练，基于紧凑的99维状态，该状态结合了极坐标LiDAR直方图与车辆遥测、自车框架路线几何和交通规则指示——无需点云编码器，无需鸟瞰视图栅格化。
tldr: CORAL通过联合设计五阶段课程和阶段自适应奖励权重，使强化学习策略在长时程城市驾驶中按序学习从任务进展到安全合规的多种行为，且仅依赖紧凑的LiDAR直方图状态表示。
en_tdlr: CORAL jointly designs a five-stage curriculum and stage-adaptive reward weights to enable reinforcement learning policies to sequentially acquire behaviors from mission progress to safety and rule compliance in long-horizon urban driving, using only compact LiDAR histogram state representations.
